description: Change DNSSEC, URL forwarding, email forwarding or a vanity nameserver. Applies at once when you act for an owner or admin and the workspace lets agents apply changes (the default); otherwise it waits in list_approvals. workflow.state says which. data: dnssec {key_tag, algorithm, digest_type, digest} (delete: digest); url_forwarding {host, forwards_to, type: masked|redirect|302, title?, meta?} (delete: host); email_forwarding {email_box, email_to} (delete: email_box); vanity_nameservers {hostname, ips} (delete: hostname).
name: change_domain_service
title: Change a domain service
